identity_and_vibe.archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST (The Dev Command Center)
identity_and_vibe.core_concept: A developer tool that feels like elite flight control. No soft edges, no muddy shadows. Pure data, sharp borders, high contrast. We are building the Anti-SaaS.

rules: NEVER use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.
Headings must use tight letter spacing. Labels must use wide tracking.
Never center-align paragraphs. Left-align text for readability.
DO NOT use teal green or teal blue (#1B93A4) for dashboards. Use Electric Cyan (#00E5FF) sparingly instead.
Never use pure #000000 or #808080 without a subtle tint.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (Technical Look). Expose the skeleton. Container uses border-collapse style layout. Items have subtle borders on right/bottom.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Slight lift (-translate-y-1), border color brightens. ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle CSS noise overlay for dark mode to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.loaders: ASCII Art retro-futuristic loaders for fetching repo data.

components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, NO soft shadows. Sharp edges (rounded-none or max rounded-sm).
components.buttons: Sharp corners or strict pill-shaped. High contrast hover states.
components.forms: Use Shadcn customized components. Input fields must have distinct focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent).
components.data_viz: Recharts with high-contrast series lines. No muddy gradients inside charts.
components.modals: Glassmorphism (Crystal/Apple variant) for modal overlays (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60) with 1px delicate inner stroke.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_system: Generous. Use p-6, p-8, p-12. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: MODE B: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel utilized. h-full on children.
grids_and_layouts.marketing_pages: MODE A: The 'Tetris' Grid. Asymmetry, Visual Tension. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 with gap-8. Span logic mixed (span-8, span-4, span-2).
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align lists, forms, tabular data.

rules: Micro-animations for hover and focus states.
Transition specifically (e.g., transition: transform 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease). NEVER use 'transition: all'.

accessibility.contrast: APCA standard. Min 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text. Ensure text over images has background scrim or text-shadow.
accessibility.focus: Focus states must have HIGHER contrast than default state.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case based on role (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').

media.icons: lucide-react (Default choice for clean, minimal technical UI)

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use Mermaid.js for pure technical documentation and diagram viewing. If complex interactive repo maps are needed, use React Force Graph 2D/3D.

instructions_to_main_agent.file_extensions: CRITICAL: Use .js and .jsx files, NOT .tsx files. Ignore previous TypeScript requirements per the Critical Rules.
instructions_to_main_agent.routing: Use React Router DOM for routing.
instructions_to_main_agent.styling: Tailwind CSS + customized Shadcn components (using raw HTML/Tailwind for complex grids).
instructions_to_main_agent.headers: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header. Use backdrop-blur and solid colors.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing_tags: Add 'data-testid' to ALL buttons, links, inputs, and tab triggers.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Use 'sonner' for toasts. Sonner component are located in '/app/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx'.
